== Exceptions.tryCatch (line 5)
| tryCatch(s)
  try
    | e
    -
      jump
        | gib Integer.parseInt(s)
    -
      jump
        | gib 0
    -

== Exceptions.multiCatch (line 13)
| multiCatch(r)
  try
    | exception
    -
      instruction
        | r.read()
    -
      case
        | exception instanceof?
        | IOException
        | RuntimeException
        | %
        -
          instruction
            | e := exception
          call
            | log(e)
        -
          instruction
            | e := exception
          call
            | log(e)
        -
    -

== Exceptions.log (line 24)
| log(e)
